The spline Cox model is measured by the spread of each term, and the random survival forest (RSF) and oblique RSF by mean absolute SurvSHAP(t) value at 365 days. Identical Charlson and Elixhauser indicators are shown as one feature.

Figure X: figure showing the hazard ratio per standard deviation of each CTPA block's ridge Cox score for deaths in days 0 to 30 and 31 to 365 after admission, with 95% patient-level bootstrap intervals. The number of features in each block is shown in brackets.
